newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish presidential election likely in October.
newsitem.headline: Irish presidential election likely in October.

text.p: Ireland's presidential election is expected to take place at the end of October following the decision by Mary Robinson to resign on September 12, Irish media said on Friday.
The government will decide the polling date after she leaves office but the election must be held within 60 days of her resignation.
Robinson announced on Thursday that she would resign 11 weeks before the end of her term to take up her new United Nations post of High Commissioner for Human Rights.
"My decision reflects the pressuring nature of the human rights agenda and the significance of the High Commissioner participating fully in the U.N. reform process," she said in a statement.
